title: US consumer prices likely increased marginally in July; data quality concerns rising
load_bearing_forecast_sentence: The CPI likely rose 0.2% last month, a Reuters survey of economists showed. The anticipated slowdown from a 0.3% increase in June would reflect a slight decline in gasoline prices, which would partially offset rising food prices.
core_forecast_sentence: [core CPI] climbed 0.3%, which would be the biggest gain since January, after rising 0.2% in June.
yoy_forecast_sentence: In the 12 months through July, core CPI is anticipated to have increased 3.0% after rising 2.9% in June.
target_disambiguation: headline MoM = 0.2% (unqualified 'The CPI'); core MoM = 0.3% (explicitly '[core CPI]'); core YoY = 3.0% (explicitly '12 months through July'); June headline MoM prior-actual = 0.3% (comparison baseline, not the forecast itself)
